subject: OneTrust: ephemeral proofing & owner shift for upload pipeline
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmepayments.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: sanjay.patel@acmepayments.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OneTrust onboarding: presign window / owner for evidence upload

Markus / Marissa —

Thanks for the run-through yesterday. We want to finish the OneTrust profile ingest this week but need clarity on two items before we open the upload window:

1) Who will be the steward for presigned uploads (proof-of-possession) from our side vs yours? We need a named owner who will receive the temporary S3 presigns and confirm success.
2) What TTL and rotation policy should we expect for ephemeral creds used in the bulk upload pipeline? Our security team prefers <= 1 hour presign windows and limited token reuse.

I've attached the initial onboarding manifest (acme_onboarding_manifest.csv) showing the CAIQ/SIG sections we plan to populate. Can your team confirm the owner and the exact Presign flow you'd like us to consume?

Appreciate a quick call if easier — our upload window target is Mon 21 Sep.

— Elena
Sr. Security Program Manager, Acme Payments
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmepayments.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmepayments.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding: presign window / owner for evidence upload

Elena — thanks, clear ask. Proposed plan below (short and actionable):

- Owner: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) will be the Redwood steward for the presign lifecycle and primary point during the upload window. He'll confirm receipt of all success/failure callbacks and hand the verified manifest back to Marissa for CAIQ stitching.
- Presign TTL: we support 15m, 1h, and 4h presign windows depending on upload batch size. For a first pass we recommend 1 hour with single-use presign URLs and S3 object-ACL set to private.
- Rotation: ephemeral creds used to generate presigns will be rotated every 45 minutes during high-volume uploads; we will publish a short playbook to your SRE/security team. See attached onetrust_tempcred_playbook.pdf for mechanics and audit events we capture.

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm you are OK with a 1 hour TTL (single-use presigns) or request 15m if you need stricter limits.
- Share the OneTrust org ID and the profile link so we can map the upload manifest to profile fields.

If you prefer, schedule a 20-minute handoff with Ben and Marissa — Ben is free Mon 09:30-11:00 PT.

On Fri, Sep 18, 2026 at 09:12 Elena Ruiz <elena@acmepayments.com> wrote:
> Markus / Marissa —
> 
> Thanks for the run-through yesterday...

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@acmepayments.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding: presign window / owner for evidence upload

Quick note — happy to take stewardship for the window. Proposed micro-plan:

1) I will create a short-run delegation matrix (delegation_matrix.xlsx) mapping who can request presigns and who can confirm receipts.
2) On the day of upload: I will open a monitoring thread and post progress every 15 minutes.
3) If we see >5% failure on presigns we will pause and provide a remediation checklist (missing ACL, truncated keys, incorrect MIME).

Availability: Mon 09:30-11:15 PT works for me. If Acme wants it earlier I can nudge earlier by 30 minutes.

Ben
Lead, Platform Onboarding — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmepayments.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmepayments.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, support@onetrust.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding: presign window / owner for evidence upload

Elena / Sanjay —

Thanks — confirmed: Ben will own the upload window and Redwood will use 1 hour single-use presigns for the initial bulk push. We will:

- Schedule the handoff call Mon 09:30 PT (invitation sent separately).
- Provide access to a short-run audit log within 24 hours of upload completion.
- Share the DocuSign delegation form for Acme to sign (link below).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/placeholder/ACME-Upload-Delegation
OneTrust profile (for mapping): https://onetrust.example.com/orgs/ACME-12345/profile

Please review the attached playbook and delegation matrix; reply with the preferred TTL if different. Once signed we will open the upload window.

— Marissa
Sr. Security Ops, Redwood Inference
